normalizations.description: Leading/trailing blank lines collapsed to exactly one terminal LF. This is the same class of transformation that separates the STO extraction's manifest hash from its on-disk hash, so it is always recorded rather than absorbed.
normalizations.name: trim_terminal_whitespace_to_single_lf

coordinate_conventions.name: utf8_char_offset
coordinate_conventions.origin: 0 at the first character of normalized.txt

coordinate_conventions.name: block_ordinal
coordinate_conventions.origin: 0 at the first block of the section

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 0
references.quote: The special uses identified in the use matrix table at TMC 18.60.010 are subject to the additional requirements of this chapter. In case of any conflict between the regulations of the district in which the use is allowed and the additional regulations of this chapter, the most restrictive regulations shall govern:

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 1
references.quote: (a) Automobile or Vehicle Dealership. This use includes the sales, leasing, and service of vehicles and trailers having a gross vehicle weight rating over 12,000 pounds, watercraft, recreational vehicles, heavy construction equipment, and agricultural equipment.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 2
references.quote: (1) Ancillary towing services and body shops are permitted. Storage of damaged vehicles needing body shop repairs shall only be stored in rear yards or screened from view from public roadways and screened from abutting residentially zoned properties. Automotive wrecking and dismantling for salvage purposes are prohibited. Each disabled vehicle is limited to 30 days of on-site storage.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 3
references.quote: (2) The inventory of vehicles for sale, lease, or service shall be parked only on paved areas and shall not displace the minimum required number of off-street parking spaces.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 4
references.quote: (3) A solid, opaque screen, fence or sight-prohibitive landscaping shall be provided along lot lines adjoining residential property at a height of not less than six feet except in front yards where it may be reduced to three feet or replaced with shrubs designed to grow two to three feet in height.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 5
references.quote: (4) Automobile dealerships shall have frontage on a roadway designated as an arterial roadway by the Shawnee County functional classification of roadways map.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 6
references.quote: (b) Automobile or Vehicle Car Wash Facility.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 7
references.quote: (1) All washing facilities shall be within the interior of the structure or beneath a roofed area.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 8
references.quote: (2) Vacuum, automatic air drying, and similar facilities shall not be located in such a manner that will restrict the orderly ingress to the facility.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 9
references.quote: (3) The washing facility shall be set back a minimum of 50 feet from any public street.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 10
references.quote: (4) All accesses, drives and off-street parking spaces shall be in accordance with the parking standards.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 11
references.quote: (5) The traffic circulation plan for the facility shall be subject to the approval of the Traffic Engineer or authorized designee of the Public Works Department.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 12
references.quote: (6) A solid, opaque screen, fence or sight-prohibitive landscaping shall be provided along lot lines adjoining residential property at a height of not less than six feet except in front yards where it may be reduced to three feet or replaced with shrubs designed to grow two to three feet in height.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 13
references.quote: (c) Automobile Sales. Except in the C-4 commercial district, ancillary uses for a body shop and automotive service station Type 3 are prohibited unless a conditional use permit is secured.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 14
references.quote: (1) Automobile sales, leasing, and service of vehicles are restricted to automobiles, pickup trucks, motorcycles and other vehicles that do not exceed a gross vehicle weight rating of 12,000 pounds in the C-3 district.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 15
references.quote: (2) The inventory of vehicles for sale, lease, or service shall be parked only on paved areas and shall not displace the minimum required number of off-street parking spaces.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 16
references.quote: (3) A solid, opaque screen, fence or sight-prohibitive landscaping shall be provided along lot lines adjoining residential property at a height of not less than six feet except in front yards where it may be reduced to three feet or replaced with shrubs designed to grow two to three feet in height.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 17
references.quote: (d) Automotive Service Station.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 18
references.quote: (1) Type 1. A facility which dispenses automotive fuels and oil with or without retail sales of incidental merchandise such as packaged beer, nonalcoholic beverages, ice, candy, cigarettes, snacks and convenience packaged foods.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 19
references.quote: (2) Type 2. A facility which may include those uses defined in Type 1 and specifically includes replacement of automotive parts including but not limited to fan belts, hoses, sparkplugs, tires and tubes, ignition parts, batteries, shock absorbers, and fuses. A Type 2 facility is limited to servicing automobiles, pickups, motorcycles and other vehicles having a gross vehicle weight rating of 12,000 pounds or less. The following automotive services shall be permitted in a Type 2 facility:

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 20
references.quote: (i) Lubrication.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 21
references.quote: (ii) Tire repair and replacement.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 22
references.quote: (iii) Brake repair and wheel balancing and alignment.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 23
references.quote: (iv) Muffler and exhaust system repair and replacement.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 24
references.quote: (v) Shock absorber and strut replacement.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 25
references.quote: (vi) Engine adjustment (tune-up).

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 26
references.quote: (vii) Replacement of pumps, cooling systems, generators, alternators, wires, starters, air conditioners, bearings and other similar devices.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 27
references.quote: (viii) Radio, GPS, rear cameras, and similar electronics installation and repair.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 28
references.quote: (ix) Glass replacement.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 29
references.quote: (x) Trailer hitch and wiring installation and repair.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 30
references.quote: (xi) And other similar repair and replacement services normally deemed to be emergency and convenience services; however, the same shall not include drive train units such as the engine, transmission or drive components.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 31
references.quote: (3) Type 3. A facility which may include those uses defined in Types 1 and 2, and specifically includes repair, rebuilding and replacement of drive train units of automobiles, pickup trucks, motorcycles, trailers, and other vehicles.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 32
references.quote: (4) For Types 1, 2, and 3 a solid, opaque screen, fence or sight-prohibitive landscaping shall be provided along lot lines adjoining residential property at a height of not less than six feet except in front yards where it may be reduced to three feet or replaced with shrubs designed to grow two to three feet in height.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 33
references.quote: (e) Automobile or Vehicle Tow Lot and Body Shop. This use includes body repair of vehicles and trailers having a gross vehicle weight rating over 12,000 pounds, watercraft, recreational vehicles, heavy construction equipment, and agricultural equipment. Facilities shall meet the following standards:

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 34
references.quote: (1) Storage of damaged vehicles requiring repairs shall only be parked on surfaces meeting City standards in rear yards or screened from view from public roadways.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 35
references.quote: (2) Vehicle wrecking and dismantling for salvage purposes are prohibited.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 36
references.quote: (3) Each disabled vehicle is limited to 30 days of on-site storage.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 37
references.quote: (4) A solid, opaque screen, fence or sight-prohibitive landscaping shall be provided along lot lines adjoining street rights-of-way and residential property at a height of not less than six feet except in front yards where it may be reduced to three feet or replaced with shrubs designed to grow two to three feet in height.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 38
references.quote: (f) Cemetery.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 39
references.quote: (1) Areas. Any cemetery established after the effective date of the ordinance codified in this division shall be located on a site containing not less than 20 acres.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 40
references.quote: (2) Setback. All structures including but not limited to a mausoleum, permanent monument or maintenance building shall be set back not less than 30 feet from any property line or street right-of-way line and all graves or burial lots shall be set back not less than 30 feet from any property line or street right-of-way line.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 41
references.quote: (3) A cemetery shall have the principal entrance or entrances on a major traffic thoroughfare designated as a collector or arterial roadway on the Shawnee County functional classification of roadways map, with ingress and egress so designed as to minimize traffic congestion.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 42
references.quote: (4) All on-site private drive locations and their widths shall be reviewed by the Traffic Engineer or designee of the Department of Public Works in respect to providing efficient vehicular access and traffic flow; and to minimize vehicle conflict with pedestrians. Development of the cemetery shall not commence until approval of the aforementioned drive locations and their widths has been secured.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 43
references.quote: (g) Community Gardens.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 44
references.quote: (1) All community gardens shall be allowed only after the owner or applicant has registered the community garden with the Planning Department and has paid a fee of $50.00. The Planning Director shall adopt administrative procedures necessary to govern the registration requirements and ensure compliance with the requirements.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 45
references.quote: (2) Community gardens shall be the primary use of the lot. The gardens may be divided into plots for cultivation by one or more individuals and/or groups or may be cultivated by individuals and/or groups collectively.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 46
references.quote: (3) Fences are allowed subject to a fence permit and compliance with TMC 18.210.040 . In R and M districts, the minimum front yard setback for the district shall act as the front face of the principal structure.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 47
references.quote: (4) Sales and operation of mechanical equipment shall occur only between 8:00 a.m. and 8:00 p.m. For Type 1 gardens, sales of produce grown on site are permissible; provided, that all stands and displays are removed at or before 8:00 p.m.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 48
references.quote: (5) Cultivation equipment shall not exceed the size of a compact utility tractor and its accessories.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 49
references.quote: (6) The cultivated area shall have a minimum setback of three feet from all property lines. Crops planted in any minimum front yard setback are limited to those that will grow to a height of four feet or less (e.g., four feet maximum in the front 30 feet).

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 50
references.quote: (7) Dead garden plants shall be removed regularly and no later than November 30th of each year.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 51
references.quote: (8) Weeds, grass, undergrowth and uncultivated plants shall not exceed a height of 12 inches.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 52
references.quote: (9) Compost bins shall be set back at least 10 feet from all side and rear property lines and 25 feet from the front property line. Compost bins shall be screened and maintained in such a manner as to not attract insects, vermin, reptiles and other animals. Appropriate best management practices shall be used to minimize odor.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 53
references.quote: (10) The site shall be designed and maintained so that no water, fertilizers, or pesticides drain onto adjacent property.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 54
references.quote: (11) The entire site shall be maintained in a manner, including noise and odors, so that it complies with Chapter 8.60 TMC.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 55
references.quote: (12) Signage is limited to one permanent identification sign per property frontage consisting of up to 10 square feet per sign face and temporary signs are allowed in accordance with TMC 18.10.170 .

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 56
references.quote: (13) Orchards and tree farms shall meet the front yard setback for their zoning district and shall be set back at least 15 feet from all other property lines, with the measurements based on the nearest part of the trees’ canopies.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 57
references.quote: (14) Accessory structures for Type I community gardens are limited to the following standards:

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 58
references.quote: (i) Accessory structures may include storage buildings, greenhouses, high tunnels and hoop houses maintained in good condition.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 59
references.quote: (ii) Maximum height of 12.5 feet.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 60
references.quote: (iii) Maximum lot coverage for structures shall be calculated based on the cultivated area for the community garden, including pathways. Maximum lot coverage for structures shall be 10 percent or less than 150 square feet, whichever is greater.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 61
references.quote: (iv) Storage buildings are limited to less than 150 square feet and may only be used for storing garden equipment and materials used on site.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 62
references.quote: (v) Each structure shall meet the required setbacks from property lines as outlined in TMC 18.60.020 . If the area of cultivated land exceeds one acre, a 50-foot setback is required between properties with existing dwelling units and any cultivated area or accessory structures.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 63
references.quote: (15) Accessory structures for Type II community gardens are limited to the following standards:

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 64
references.quote: (i) In addition to Type I standards, Type II permitted accessory structures include: garden sales stands, other buildings for storage, structures for cold storage and processing of garden products, and buildings for aquaculture, aquaponics, and hydroponics.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 65
references.quote: (ii) Maximum lot coverage for structures is 30 percent of the site area designated for the community garden (cultivated area and pathways).

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 66
references.quote: (iii) Accessory structures 150 square feet or greater are permitted, subject to required building permits.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 67
references.quote: (16) If one or more of the requirements cannot be met, a person may apply for a conditional use permit pursuant to Chapter 18.215 TMC.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 68
references.quote: (h) Day Care Facility, Type I.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 69
references.quote: (1) An on-site automobile drop-off/pickup area for a minimum of two vehicles shall be provided for a facility which only has street frontage on a major traffic thoroughfare as designated by the transportation plan; and said drop-off/pickup shall be in accordance with any applicable provisions of said plan.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 70
references.quote: (2) Playground equipment or structures shall not be permitted to be located in a required yard adjacent to a public street.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 71
references.quote: (i) Day Care Facility, Type II.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 72
references.quote: (1) An on-site automobile drop-off/pickup area for a minimum of two vehicles shall be provided for a facility which only has street frontage on a roadway that is classified as a collector or arterial roadway on the Shawnee County functional classification of roadways map; and said drop-off/pickup shall be provided in accordance with any applicable provisions of said plan.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 73
references.quote: (j) Demolition Landfill.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 74
references.quote: (1) The applicant shall submit documentation showing compliance with all licenses or permits required by the State Department of Health and Environment prior to construction and within 30 days of renewal of any State licenses and permits. The site shall maintain a neat appearance along all public road frontages and along all property boundaries abutting residential zoning districts.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 75
references.quote: (k) Dwelling Units on Main Floor. Dwelling units located on main floors shall meet the following requirements:

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 76
references.quote: (1) The units must be subordinate in area or location to nonresidential uses on the main floor; or

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 77
references.quote: (2) The units shall be allowed in structures that were originally built for use as dwelling units, the structure has been used historically for dwelling units, or the dwelling units were converted from hospital, school, or hotel rooms.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 78
references.quote: (3) For land classified D-1 or X-3, requirements in subsections (k)(1) and (k)(2) of this section for dwellings on main floor apply exclusively to parcels of land and buildings abutting Kansas Avenue between 6th Avenue and 10th Avenue, and between Gordon Street and Norris Street.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 79
references.quote: (4) Conditional Use Permit. Land use development not meeting the requirements of this section may be approved by conditional use permit pursuant to Chapter 18.215 TMC.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 80
references.quote: (l) Extraction, Processing, Storage and Sale of Raw Materials, Including Ore, Minerals, Sand, Rock, Stone, Gravel, Topsoil, Fill Dirt, and Other Materials Delivered by Quarry, Mining, Dredging, or Stripping Operations. In addition to the standard application components required of an applicant to petition for a conditional use permit, a request for the subject use shall identify the specific raw material and type of operation under consideration and, furthermore, shall include the below-listed additional information, plans and data:

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 81
references.quote: (1) Site Plan. A site plan prepared by a registered civil engineer, drawn to scale on a sheet measuring 24 inches by 36 inches in size and including the following:

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 82
references.quote: (i) Contour intervals: two feet for slopes 30 percent or less; 10 feet for greater slopes when map scale is one inch equals 100 feet.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 83
references.quote: (ii) Contour intervals: two feet for slopes 20 percent or less; 10 feet for greater slopes when map scale is one inch equals 200 feet.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 84
references.quote: (iii) Identify name, grade, right-of-way and street width of existing and proposed streets extending through or adjacent to the site.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 85
references.quote: (iv) Identify width and purpose of easements extending through or adjacent to the site.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 86
references.quote: (v) Identify natural land features including but not limited to watercourses and drainageways, floodplains, rock outcropping, springs, wooded areas, etc.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 87
references.quote: (vi) Identify manmade features such as buildings and other structures, dams, dikes and impoundments of water.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 88
references.quote: (vii) Identify all of the above-noted adjacent land features within 300 feet of the site. In addition, show all platted subdivision lots and metes and bounds parcels.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 89
references.quote: (viii) Show location of at least five borings, which show depths to groundwater.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 90
references.quote: (ix) Provide a cross-section to illustrate physical conditions of the site. Show vertical scale equal to, or in exaggeration of, horizontal scale.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 91
references.quote: (2) Development Plan. A development plan prepared in the same manner as the site plan and including the following:

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 92
references.quote: (i) North point, scale and date.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 93
references.quote: (ii) Extent of area to be excavated.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 94
references.quote: (iii) Location, dimension and intended use of proposed structures.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 95
references.quote: (iv) Location of all areas on the property subject to inundation or flood hazard, and the location, width, and directions of flow of all watercourses and flood control channels that may be affected by the excavation.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 96
references.quote: (v) Benchmarks.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 97
references.quote: (vi) Typical cross-section, at sufficient intervals, showing the extent of overburden, extent of sand and gravel deposits or rock, and the water table.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 98
references.quote: (vii) Identification of processing and storage areas, the boundaries of which to be shown to scale.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 99
references.quote: (viii) Proposed fencing, gates, parking areas and signs.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 100
references.quote: (ix) Sequences of operation showing approximate areas involved shall be shown to scale and serially numbered with a description of each.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 101
references.quote: (x) Ingress/egress roads including on-site haul roads and proposed surface treatment and means to limit dust.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 102
references.quote: (xi) A map showing access routes between the property and the nearest arterial road.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 103
references.quote: (xii) Location of screening berms shall be shown to scale, and notes shall be provided indicating when they will be used as reclamation material. In the same manner overburden storage areas shall be identified and noted.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 104
references.quote: (xiii) Proposed location of settling basins and process water ponds.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 105
references.quote: (xiv) Site drainage features shall also be shown and flow direction indicated.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 106
references.quote: (3) A restriction of use statement, which shall include:

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 107
references.quote: (i) The approximate date of commencement of the excavation and the duration of the operation.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 108
references.quote: (ii) Proposed hours of operation and days of operation.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 109
references.quote: (iii) Estimated type and volume of the excavation.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 110
references.quote: (iv) Method of extracting and processing, including the disposition of overburden or top soils.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 111
references.quote: (v) Equipment proposed to be used in the operation of the excavation.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 112
references.quote: (vi) Operating practices proposed to be used to minimize noise, dust, air contaminants, and vibration.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 113
references.quote: (vii) Methods to prevent erosion and pollution of surface or underground water.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 114
references.quote: (4) Reclamation Plan. A reclamation plan prepared in the same manner as the site plan and including the following:

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 115
references.quote: (i) A statement of planned reclamation, including methods of accomplishment, phasing, and timing.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 116
references.quote: (ii) A plan indicating: the final grade of the excavation; any water features included in the reclamation and methods planned to prevent stagnation and pollution; landscaping or vegetative planting; and areas of cut or fill. This plan, if clearly delineated, may be included with the site plan. For quarry applications, the final grade shall mean the approximate planned final grade.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 117
references.quote: (iii) A phasing plan, if the excavation of the site is to be accomplished in phases. This plan shall indicate the area and extent of each phase and the approximate timing of each phase.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 118
references.quote: (iv) The method of disposing of any equipment or structures used in the operation of the excavation upon completion of the excavation.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 119
references.quote: (v) Show location of any proposed streets within the reclaimed area and their connection to present public streets beyond.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 120
references.quote: (vi) Show location of any lakes, ponds, or streams proposed within the reclaimed area and their connections to streams or drainageways beyond.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 121
references.quote: (vii) Show areas where vegetation is to be established, and indicate types of vegetative cover.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 122
references.quote: (m) Golf Course – Country Club.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 123
references.quote: (1) A golf course or country club shall be established on a minimum contiguous area of 20 acres and shall consist of a minimum of nine holes.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 124
references.quote: (2) Vehicular access to a golf course or country club may ingress/egress directly to a local street provided the local street intersects with a roadway that is classified as a collector or arterial roadway on the Shawnee County functional classification of roadways map; and further provided, that said points of ingress/egress are located within 300 feet of the centerline of the aforementioned thoroughfare.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 125
references.quote: (3) All patron parking lots, clubhouses and recreational facilities, other than those for golf, shall be located a minimum distance of 500 feet from all property boundaries of the golf course or country club.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 126
references.quote: (4) All maintenance facilities and employee parking lots shall be located a minimum distance of 200 feet from all property boundaries of the golf course or country club.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 127
references.quote: (5) If one or more of the requirements cannot be met, a person may apply for a conditional use permit pursuant to Chapter 18.215 TMC.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 128
references.quote: (n) Indoor Gun Range.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 129
references.quote: (1) A building for the safe discharge of firearms shall meet the following requirements:

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 130
references.quote: (i) The building shall be designed so that discharged ammunition does not escape the confines of the building.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 131
references.quote: (ii) Discharge noise does not adversely impact neighboring properties.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 132
references.quote: (iii) The building shall be located at least 200 feet from any residentially zoned property.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 133
references.quote: (2) If one or more of the requirements cannot be met, a person may apply for a conditional use permit pursuant to Chapter 18.215 TMC.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 134
references.quote: (o) Outdoor Storage of Nonmerchandise. When storage is located in a yard that abuts or is located across the street from residentially zoned property it shall be screened from public view by a solid, opaque screen, fence or sight-prohibitive landscaping of not less than six feet in height, except in front yards where it may be reduced to three feet or replaced with shrubs designed to grow two to three feet in height. If storage is adjacent to driveways or intersections, screening may be reduced to comply with sight distance triangles, as outlined in TMC 12.20.020 .

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 135
references.quote: (p) Reception, Conference and Assembly Facility.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 136
references.quote: (1) As an independent principal use within any subdistrict of the residential dwelling and multiple-family dwelling districts, the facility shall be located only within a structure that exists on the date of the adoption of these regulations, except for the RR-1 district; and further, vehicle parking lots shall not be permitted within the established front yard setback.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 137
references.quote: (2) All applications requesting a conditional use permit shall include and address the following considerations in respect to:

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 138
references.quote: (i) Maximum occupant load at any one time.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 139
references.quote: (ii) Presentation of a plan of operation which shall include:

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 140
references.quote: (A) Days of the week and hours of operation in which the facility will function.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 141
references.quote: (B) Any permitted outdoor activities.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 142
references.quote: (C) Supervision of guests and arrangements for enforcement of any provisions of the conditional use permit.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 143
references.quote: (iii) Any proposed screening, buffering, or landscape plan.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 144
references.quote: (iv) On-site vehicle parking and ingress/egress plan.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 145
references.quote: (v) Address the general applicability of building, life safety, and associated codes and standards to the facility.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 146
references.quote: (3) All activities of the facility as a conditional use permit shall be by prearranged lease, contract, or agreement and therefore the facility shall not be open to the general public.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 147
references.quote: (q) Recycling Depot. Recycling depots shall meet the following requirements:

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 148
references.quote: (1) Limited to the collection, storage and processing of metal, glass or plastic food or beverage containers and paper resources as an initial phase of a recycling process.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 149
references.quote: (2) The recycling process shall be limited to the volume reduction of such materials by mechanical and hand sorting methods only.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 150
references.quote: (3) All storage and processing operations in conjunction therewith shall be contained within the principal structure.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 151
references.quote: (r) Religious Assembly.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 152
references.quote: (1) Vehicular access to a facility of religious assembly may ingress/egress directly to a local street, provided said local street intersects with a major traffic thoroughfare as designated on the transportation plan; and further provided, that said points of ingress/egress are located within 300 feet of the centerline of the aforementioned thoroughfare.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 153
references.quote: (2) If one or more of the requirements cannot be met, a person may apply for a conditional use permit pursuant to Chapter 18.215 TMC.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 154
references.quote: (s) Relocation, Remodeling or Rebuilding of Legal Nonconforming Billboards. No application for a conditional use permit to relocate, remodel, or rebuild an existing legal nonconforming billboard shall be approved unless the Governing Body, upon recommendation by the Planning Commission, shall determine that the proposed billboard is appropriate in the location proposed based upon its consideration of the standards set forth below.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 155
references.quote: (1) This subsection shall apply only to existing legal nonconforming billboards presently located within the C-4 commercial district. In seeking a conditional use permit, the applicant shall specify the location, size, height and area of the existing billboard proposed to be removed.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 156
references.quote: (2) The structural members of all billboard materials shall be constructed entirely of noncombustible materials excepting only the sign face, ornamental molding and platform and shall be installed only on single-pole structures.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 157
references.quote: (3) The proposed relocated sign shall not be larger than the existing billboard proposed to be removed, but not to exceed 750 square feet including extensions; nor shall such relocated sign have more than two sign faces.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 158
references.quote: (4) No billboard to be relocated shall be erected upon the roof of any building or attached to any building.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 159
references.quote: (5) No billboard to be relocated shall be set back less than 20 feet from any public right-of-way line.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 160
references.quote: (6) No billboard to be relocated shall be either less than 1,320 feet from any other such sign on the same street or closer than a 400-foot radius on different streets.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 161
references.quote: (7) No billboard to be relocated shall be less than 200 feet from any underpass, overpass or bridge structure.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 162
references.quote: (8) No billboard to be relocated shall be placed within 300 feet of a residential dwelling, which fronts on the same street right-of-way, nor within 500 feet of any religious assembly or public or private elementary or secondary school on the same street.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 163
references.quote: (9) No billboard shall result in the loss or damage of natural, scenic, or historic features of significant importance; and shall be constructed and operated with minimal interference of the use and development of neighborhood property.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 164
references.quote: (10) No billboard shall be so designed to include the vertical stacking of billboards on the sign pole. Each billboard shall be comprised of a single sign face oriented in a given direction. This provision does not preclude double-sided billboards where arranged back to back on the sign pole.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 165
references.quote: (t) Manufactured Home. A manufactured home for the purpose, use and occupancy of a family shall meet the following requirements:

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 166
references.quote: (1) The manufactured home shall have a minimum dimension of 14 body feet in width for the principal structure.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 167
references.quote: (2) The manufactured home shall be secured to the ground on a permanent foundation.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 168
references.quote: (3) The undercarriage of the manufactured home shall be completely screened from view by the foundation or skirting, such skirting to be of material harmonious to the unit structure and installed within 10 days of unit placement.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 169
references.quote: (4) The manufactured home shall have the towing apparatus, wheels, axles, and transporting lights removed.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 170
references.quote: (5) The manufactured home shall have an exterior facade of vinyl or wood siding, stone, brick, or other nonmetallic material.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 171
references.quote: (6) The roof of the manufactured home shall be double pitched and have a nominal vertical rise of three inches for each 12 inches of horizontal run, and shall be covered with material that is residential in appearance, including but not limited to wood, asphalt, composition or fiberglass shingles, but excluding corrugated aluminum, corrugated fiberglass, or corrugated metal roofing material. The roof shall have a minimum eave projection or overhang of 10 inches on at least two sides, which may include a four-inch gutter.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 172
references.quote: (u) Retail Merchandise Outdoor Display. Items for sale that are displayed outside buildings, exclusive of very large items such as vehicles and construction materials, shall meet the following standards:

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 173
references.quote: (1) The display area shall not exceed 50 percent of the first floor area of the business.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 174
references.quote: (2) Screening shall be provided between the merchandise being stored and residentially zoned properties when the merchandise is located in a side or rear yard next to residentially zoned properties. Merchandise shall not be stacked higher than the screening in this area.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 175
references.quote: (3) The inventory of vehicles and equipment for sale, lease, or service shall not displace the minimum required number of off-street parking spaces.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 176
references.quote: (4) In D and X districts, retail merchandise outdoor display areas shall occur only during normal business hours. The outdoor display area shall provide adequate pedestrian clearance and shall not obstruct vehicular or pedestrian circulation.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 177
references.quote: (v) Self-Storage, Type I. An indoor storage facility for individuals and small businesses shall meet the following specific requirements:

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 178
references.quote: (1) Any new building shall have exterior design characteristics similar to retail buildings in the area.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 179
references.quote: (2) Only one large common dock/garage door opening shall be allowed per building and shall not face any street frontage unless appropriately screened.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 180
references.quote: (3) All items being stored must be inside of an enclosed building.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 181
references.quote: (4) No business activity shall be conducted in the individual storage units.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 182
references.quote: (5) No living quarters are allowed within the individual units but the overall premises may have one dwelling unit for the caretaker.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 183
references.quote: (6) The storage of hazardous, toxic, or explosive substances is prohibited.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 184
references.quote: (w) Animal Care and Services, Type I.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 185
references.quote: (1) Medical treatment or care of large animals such as horses, cattle, sheep, goats, swine, etc., shall not be permitted on the premises.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 186
references.quote: (2) Medical treatment or care shall be provided only within the confines of an enclosed building or structure.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 187
references.quote: (3) The building or structure shall be constructed in such a manner as to prevent audible noise and/or odor from adversely impacting adjoining properties.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 188
references.quote: (x) Television, Radio, and Microwave Transmission Towers – Telecommunication Equipment – Accessory Facilities. In addition to the standard application components required of an applicant to petition for a conditional use permit, a petition for a conditional use permit for the subject use shall include:

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 189
references.quote: (1) A site plan or plans drawn to scale of one inch equals 30 feet or larger and identifying the site boundary; tower(s); guy wire anchors; existing and proposed structures; vehicular parking and access; existing vegetation to be retained, removed, or replaced; and uses, structures, and land use designations on the site and abutting parcels.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 190
references.quote: (2) A plan drawn to scale showing any proposed landscaping, including species type, size, spacing, and other features.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 191
references.quote: (3) The applicant shall provide written communications obtained from the Federal Communications Commission and the Federal Aviation Administration indicating whether the proposed tower complies with applicable regulations administered by that agency or that the tower is exempt from those regulations. If each applicable agency does not provide a requested statement after the applicant makes a timely, good-faith effort to obtain it, the application is complete. The applicant shall send a subsequently received agency statement to the Planning Director.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 192
references.quote: (4) The applicant shall demonstrate that the tower complies with any applicable provisions of the airport hazard zone regulations if the tower site is located within the hazard zone as established by said regulations.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 193
references.quote: (y) Vehicle Surface Parking Lot.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 194
references.quote: (1) The parking lot site shall be of like district zoning classification as that of an associated principal use or that of a less restrictive district. The parking lot site shall not be separated from the associated principal use by an intervening zoning district of a more restrictive classification.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 195
references.quote: (2) The parking lot site shall not be separated from an associated principal use by an intervening public street right-of-way classified as a collector or arterial roadway on the Shawnee County functional classification of roadways map.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 196
references.quote: (3) The nearest point of a parking lot site to the nearest point of the building served by the parking lot shall not be greater than 500 feet.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 197
references.quote: (4) If one or more of the requirements cannot be met, a person may apply for a conditional use permit pursuant to Chapter 18.215 TMC.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 198
references.quote: (z) Short-Term Residential Rental, Type I.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 199
references.quote: (1) Specific Requirements. Each short-term residential rental, type I shall meet all of the following requirements unless waived as part of the conditional use permit process:

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 200
references.quote: (i) The primary entrance to all rooms accessible to guests shall be within the dwelling. An original secondary exterior entrance opening onto a porch or balcony or from a basement unit is allowed.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 201
references.quote: (ii) The exterior of the dwelling and premises shall outwardly remain and appear to be a dwelling giving no appearance of a business use.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 202
references.quote: (iii) Individual guestrooms shall not contain cooking facilities.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 203
references.quote: (iv) The short-term residential rental, type I shall not be used for weddings, receptions, large parties or gatherings, business meetings, or similar activities.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 204
references.quote: (v) Signage shall comply with the sign regulations applicable to residential uses.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 205
references.quote: (vi) Only retail sales of a nature clearly incidental and subordinate to the primary use of the premises as a short-term residential rental establishment shall be permitted.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 206
references.quote: (vii) Parking shall comply with the parking requirements of Chapter 18.240 TMC.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 207
references.quote: (viii) Parking of commercial vehicles by transient guests is not permitted.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 208
references.quote: (ix) In nonresidential zoning districts, the dwelling containing the short-term residential rental shall conform to the use standards of TMC 18.60.010 or be a legal nonconforming use.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 209
references.quote: (x) The trash and recycling receptacles shall be of sufficient size and number to accommodate all refuse generated by the owner-occupant and the guests.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 210
references.quote: (xi) Outdoor activities shall not produce any excessive, unnecessary, unusual or loud noises which: (A) create a nuisance; or (B) interfere with the use or enjoyment of property of any person of reasonable sensibilities.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 211
references.quote: (2) Administrative Permit. Upon receipt of an application and payment of permit fee to be determined by the Director, the Director will determine whether the application meets the requirements in this subsection (z). Upon approval, the Director will issue the permit and notify owners of all parcels adjacent to the subject property of the issuance of the permit. The administrative permit shall be valid for two years and may be renewed upon a finding of compliance with the requirements and payment of a fee to be determined by the Director. The Director may deny an application, revoke, or suspend a permit for failure to comply with this subsection (z). The applicant or permit holder may appeal the Director’s determination to the Board of Zoning Appeals. An administrative permit is not required if a conditional use permit is granted.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 212
references.quote: (3) Conditional Use Permit. In the event that a person cannot meet the requirements of subsections (z)(1)(i) through (z)(1)(vi) or (z)(1)(viii) through (z)(1)(x) of this section, such person may apply for a conditional use permit pursuant to Chapter 18.215 TMC.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 213
references.quote: (aa) Short-Term Residential Rental, Type II.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 214
references.quote: (1) Specific Requirements. Each short-term residential rental, type II shall meet all of the following requirements unless waived as part of the conditional use permit process:

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 215
references.quote: (i) The primary entrance to all rooms accessible to guests shall be within the dwelling. An original secondary exterior entrance opening onto a porch or balcony or from a basement unit is allowed.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 216
references.quote: (ii) The exterior of the dwelling and premises shall outwardly remain and appear to be a dwelling giving no appearance of a business use.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 217
references.quote: (iii) Individual guestrooms shall not contain cooking facilities.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 218
references.quote: (iv) The short-term residential rental, type II shall not be used for weddings, receptions, large parties or gatherings, business meetings, or similar activities.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 219
references.quote: (v) Signage shall comply with the sign regulations applicable to residential uses.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 220
references.quote: (vi) Only retail sales of a nature clearly incidental and subordinate to the primary use of the premises as a short-term residential rental shall be permitted.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 221
references.quote: (vii) Parking shall comply with the parking requirements of Chapter 18.240 TMC.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 222
references.quote: (viii) Parking of commercial vehicles by transient guests is not permitted.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 223
references.quote: (ix) Any short-term residential rental, type II in an R, M-1, or M-1a district established after March 1, 2021, shall be no closer than 500 feet from another short-term residential rental, type II or short-term residential rental, type III in an R, M-1, or M-1a district.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 224
references.quote: (x) In nonresidential zoning districts, the dwelling containing the short-term residential rental shall conform to the use standards of TMC 18.60.010 or be a legal nonconforming use.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 225
references.quote: (xi) The trash and recycling receptacles shall be of sufficient size and number to accommodate all refuse generated by the guests.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 226
references.quote: (xii) Outdoor activities shall not produce any excessive, unnecessary, unusual or loud noises which: (A) create a nuisance; or (B) interfere with the use or enjoyment of property of any person of reasonable sensibilities.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 227
references.quote: (2) Administrative Permit. Upon receipt of an application and payment of permit fee as prescribed by the City’s fee schedule, the Director will determine whether the application meets the requirements in this subsection (aa). Upon approval, the Director will issue the permit and notify owners of all parcels adjacent to the subject property of the issuance of the permit. The administrative permit shall be valid for two years and may be renewed upon a finding of compliance with the requirements and payment of a fee to be determined by the Director. The Director may deny an application, revoke, or suspend a permit for failure to comply with this subsection (aa). The applicant or permit holder may appeal the Director’s determination to the Board of Zoning Appeals. An administrative permit is not required if a conditional use permit is granted.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 228
references.quote: (3) Conditional Use Permit. In the event that a person cannot meet the requirements of subsections (aa)(1)(i) through (aa)(1)(vi) or (aa)(1)(viii) through (aa)(1)(xi) of this section, such person may apply for a conditional use permit pursuant to Chapter 18.215 TMC.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 229
references.quote: (bb) Short-Term Residential Rental, Type III.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 230
references.quote: (1) Specific Requirements. A conditional use permit is required for each short-term residential rental, type III in the zoning districts designated in TMC 18.60.010 . In those districts where a conditional use permit is required or where specific use requirements are imposed, the following standards shall apply unless waived as part of the conditional use process:

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 231
references.quote: (i) The short-term residential rental, type III shall be operated within the single-family dwelling and not in any accessory structure.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 232
references.quote: (ii) The primary entrance to all rooms accessible to guests shall be within the dwelling. An original secondary exterior entrance opening onto a porch or balcony or from a basement unit is allowed.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 233
references.quote: (iii) The exterior of the dwelling and premises shall outwardly remain and appear to be a dwelling giving no appearance of a business use.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 234
references.quote: (iv) Individual guestrooms shall not contain cooking facilities.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 235
references.quote: (v) Signage shall be regulated by the sign regulations except as allowed or restricted by conditional use permit.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 236
references.quote: (vi) Only retail sales of a nature clearly incidental and subordinate to the primary use of the premises as a short-term residential rental shall be permitted.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 237
references.quote: (vii) Parking shall comply with the parking requirements of Chapter 18.240 TMC.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 238
references.quote: (viii) Parking of commercial vehicles by transient guests is not permitted.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 239
references.quote: (ix) The trash and recycling receptacles shall be of sufficient size and number to accommodate all refuse generated by the guests.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 240
references.quote: (x) Outdoor activities shall not produce any excessive, unnecessary, unusual or loud noises which: (A) create a nuisance; or (B) which interfere with the use or enjoyment of property of any person of reasonable sensibilities.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 241
references.quote: (xi) Social events such as weddings, receptions, parties, business engagements or similar activities may be accommodated in conjunction with a short-term residential rental, type III, subject to the following requirements:

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 242
references.quote: (A) The scheduling and conduct of social events shall be incidental and subordinate to the principal use of the premises.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 243
references.quote: (B) All scheduled events shall be by prearranged contract or agreement. Such events shall not be open to the general public.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 244
references.quote: (C) Social events shall be restricted to between the hours of 9:00 a.m. and 11:00 p.m.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 245
references.quote: (D) Parking for Social Events. Off-street parking for event guests shall meet the same number requirements as required by TMC 18.240.030 for religious assembly or cultural facilities.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 246
references.quote: (2) Conditional Use Permit. In the event that a person cannot meet the requirements of subsections (bb)(1)(i) through (bb)(1)(vi) or (bb)(1)(viii) , (bb)(1)(ix) , or (bb)(1)(xi) of this section, such person may apply for a conditional use permit pursuant to Chapter 18.215 TMC.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 247
references.quote: (cc) Management/Leasing Office and Maintenance Facility.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 248
references.quote: (1) A facility for leasing, managing and/or maintaining a residential community shall meet the following requirements:

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 249
references.quote: (i) The proposed facility shall be located within the boundaries of and operate exclusively in association with a legally described residential community consisting of rental housing units. Activity not associated with the management of the residential community or that serves the residents of the community shall not be permitted within the facility.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 250
references.quote: (ii) The proposed facility shall be comparable in design, construction, materials, siding and roofing to the rental units located within the residential community.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 251
references.quote: (iii) All materials, equipment and supplies shall be maintained within the facility or within a detached accessory structure that is comparable in size and design to other detached accessory structures located within the residential community.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 252
references.quote: (iv) A building sign is limited to one wall-mounted identification sign not exceeding six square feet.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 253
references.quote: (2) If one or more of the requirements cannot be met, a person may apply for a conditional use permit pursuant to Chapter 18.215 TMC.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 254
references.quote: (dd) Automobile Rental Establishments.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 255
references.quote: (1) Automobiles, pickup trucks, motorcycles and other vehicles shall not exceed a gross vehicle weight rating of 12,000 pounds in the C-2 district.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 256
references.quote: (2) No automobile sales and/or long-term leasing of vehicles exceeding six months shall be permitted.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 257
references.quote: (3) No on-site vehicle maintenance or mechanical service shall be permitted except to clean and prepare a vehicle for rental.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 258
references.quote: (4) No gasoline service shall be provided on site.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 259
references.quote: (5) No exterior storage or display of products, materials, supplies or equipment shall be permitted except for the rental vehicles.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 260
references.quote: (6) The inventory of rental vehicles shall be parked only on paved areas and shall not displace the required number of off-street parking spaces to be provided.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 261
references.quote: (7) A solid, opaque screen, fence or sight-prohibitive landscaping shall be provided along lot lines adjoining residential property at a height of not less than six feet except in front yards where it may be reduced to three feet or replaced with shrubs designed to grow two to three feet in height.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 262
references.quote: (ee) Group Residence, General – Group Residence, Limited – Correctional Placement Residence or Facility, General – Correctional Placement Residence or Facility, Limited – Home Care, Type II. In considering an application for a conditional use permit for a correctional placement residence or facility, general; a correctional placement residence or facility, limited; home care, type II; a group residence, general; or a group residence, limited, the Planning Commission and Governing Body will give consideration to the following criteria:

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 263
references.quote: (1) The conformance of the proposed use to the comprehensive plan and other adopted planning policies.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 264
references.quote: (2) The character of the neighborhood including but not limited to: land use, zoning, density (residential), architectural style, building materials, height, structural mass, siting, open space and floor-to-area ratio (commercial and industrial).

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 265
references.quote: (3) The zoning and uses of nearby properties, and the extent to which the proposed use would be in harmony with such zoning and uses.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 266
references.quote: (4) The suitability of the property for the uses to which it has been restricted under the applicable zoning district regulations.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 267
references.quote: (5) The length of time the property has remained vacant as zoned.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 268
references.quote: (6) The extent to which approval of the application would detrimentally affect nearby properties.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 269
references.quote: (7) The extent to which the proposed use would substantially harm the value of nearby properties.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 270
references.quote: (8) The extent to which the proposed use would adversely affect the capacity or safety of that portion of the road network influenced by the use, or present parking problems in the vicinity of the property.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 271
references.quote: (9) The extent to which the proposed use would create excessive air pollution, water pollution, noise pollution or other environmental harm.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 272
references.quote: (10) The economic impact of the proposed use on the community.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 273
references.quote: (11) The gain, if any, to the public health, safety and welfare due to denial of the application as compared to the hardship imposed upon the landowner, if any, as a result of denial of the application.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 274
references.quote: (ff) Mobile Retail Vendors. Mobile retail vendors are allowed in zoning districts where retail sales are permitted per TMC 18.60.010 or where allowed by ordinance.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 275
references.quote: (gg) Micro-Alcohol Production in X-2 and X-3 and D Districts.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 276
references.quote: (1) Micro-breweries are limited to 5,000 barrels per year.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 277
references.quote: (2) Tap rooms and tasting rooms are permitted as an accessory use and shall be located near the streetfront side of the building.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 278
references.quote: (3) Any portion of the building that fronts a public street shall have a storefront facade and include windows and door openings along the street frontage.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 279
references.quote: (4) The area of the building used for manufacturing, processing, brewing, fermenting, distilling, or storage shall be above or below the ground floor or located to the rear of the building or otherwise subordinate in area and extent.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 280
references.quote: (hh) Artisan Manufacturing.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 281
references.quote: (1) The area used for production and assembly shall be limited to no more than 80 percent of the gross floor area of the principal structure and shall not exceed a total of 6,000 square feet.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 282
references.quote: (2) All activities and equipment associated with all aspects of artisan manufacturing shall be confined to the interior of structures located on the property.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 283
references.quote: (3) In C-1, X-3, D-1 and D-2 districts, artisan manufacturing occurring on the ground level within a designated district classification must retain the front portion of the ground level to serve as a storefront entrance to a showroom, retail space, office use, or permitted residential use, consistent with the general character of the adjacent properties.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 284
references.quote: (4) The production process shall not produce offensive chemical odors, dust, vibration, noise, or other offensive external impacts that are detectable beyond the boundaries of the subject property.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 285
references.quote: (5) Retail sales of the product produced on site are allowed. On-site retail sales of other nonrelated products are permitted.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 286
references.quote: (ii) Drive-Up/Drive-Through Facilities.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 287
references.quote: (1) In D and X districts, the drive-up window, menu boards and all lanes needed for vehicle stacking shall be located to the rear or side of the principal building.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 288
references.quote: (2) In D and X districts, the drive-up window facility shall be secondary and subordinate in size to the principal uses of the structure in which the drive-up facility is located.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 289
references.quote: (3) All lanes used for ingress, stacking, service, and egress shall be integrated safely and effectively with circulation and parking facilities.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 290
references.quote: (4) Ingress and egress shall be designed to minimize potential conflicts with vehicular, pedestrian, and bicycle traffic.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 291
references.quote: (5) The location and design of the drive-up facility shall minimize blank walls on street-facing exteriors of the building and disruption of existing or potential retail and other active ground floor uses.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 292
references.quote: (6) Approval of a traffic impact analysis by the City Traffic Engineer may be required.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 293
references.quote: (7) The principal use of the building is allowed in the zoning district.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 294
references.quote: (jj) Building, Construction, and Mechanical Contractor Office – Contractor Yards. Outdoor storage associated with a contractor office or contractor yard, when located along a lot line adjoining a visible public street or in a yard that abuts a residential use or mixed use zoning district, shall be screened from public view by a solid, opaque screen, fence or sight-prohibitive landscaping of not less than six feet in height. If storage is adjacent to driveways or intersections, screening may be reduced to comply with sight distance triangles, as provided in TMC 12.20.020 .

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 295
references.quote: (kk) Small Cell Wireless Facilities (SCWFs).

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 296
references.quote: (1) Application. An applicant for placement of an SCWF shall submit site plans, elevation drawings and structural calculations prepared by a professional engineer licensed by the State of Kansas. The drawings must depict transmission equipment, power source, electrical service pedestal and any associated access or utility easements and setbacks.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 297
references.quote: (2) Right-of-Way. If placement is sited in public right-of-way, the applicant will execute a license agreement with the City.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 298
references.quote: (3) Compliance with Aesthetic Requirements. The proposed SCWF shall comply with the City of Topeka/Shawnee County Small Cell Wireless Facilities General Design and Aesthetic Requirements posted on the City’s website.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 299
references.quote: (ll) Warehouse, Storage, Distribution Facilities.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 300
references.quote: (1) Any new warehouse, storage, or distribution facility shall be in an existing building. Minor additions are limited to expansions of 10 percent or less to the existing building.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 301
references.quote: (2) Only one large common dock/garage door opening shall be allowed per building facade facing a public street; or, if the building contains existing large door openings on facade facing street, no more than one additional large door is permitted.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 302
references.quote: (3) All items being stored must be inside of an enclosed building.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 303
references.quote: (mm) Accessory Dwelling Unit (ADU).

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 304
references.quote: (1) Generally. A single ADU is permitted as an accessory use to the principal dwelling and allowed subject to satisfying these standards.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 305
references.quote: (2) ADUs are classified into the following types:

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 306
references.quote: (i) Integrated accessory dwelling (conversion or addition within or onto principal dwelling).

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 307
references.quote: (ii) Detached accessory dwelling (conversion or new construction of detached building).

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 308
references.quote: (3) Purpose.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 309
references.quote: (i) Create new housing units while preserving the character of single-family detached residential neighborhoods.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 310
references.quote: (ii) Allow more efficient use of the City’s existing housing stock, infrastructure, and services, and preserve open space.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 311
references.quote: (iii) Provide a mix of housing types in a traditional neighborhood setting and accommodate nontraditional living environments while respecting the scale, location and design of the principal single-family dwelling.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 312
references.quote: (iv) Provide a broader range of accessible and affordable housing to promote aging in place.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 313
references.quote: (4) Standards.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 314
references.quote: (i) Applicable to ADUs with approval level “S/C” in TMC 18.60.010 , Use Tables.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 315
references.quote: (ii) Detached accessory dwellings shall contain no more than 800 square feet, exclusive of garages attached to the accessory dwelling, or 50 percent of the gross floor area of the principal dwelling, whichever is less.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 316
references.quote: (iii) Integrated Accessory Dwellings.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 317
references.quote: (A) Shall contain no more than 800 square feet and shall not exceed 80 percent of the area of the principal dwelling.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 318
references.quote: (B) Shall be separated from the principal dwelling by a wall, floor, or ceiling and have a separate entrance from the exterior.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 319
references.quote: (C) Shall be designed and constructed in a manner integrated with the architecture of the principal dwelling.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 320
references.quote: (D) For means of accessing the ADU, exterior stairways may be located on either the side or rear of the primary dwelling. The stairway shall not be located on any street facing façade.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 321
references.quote: (E) The windows for the integrated ADU, if visible from the street, shall match those in the principal dwelling in proportion and orientation.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 322
references.quote: (F) Eaves shall project from the building wall the same distance as the eaves on the rest of the principal dwelling.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 323
references.quote: (G) Shall not have a new, exclusive or separate entrance, visible from the street, on the same street-facing building elevation as the principal dwelling.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 324
references.quote: (iv) Second story additions for detached garages must comply with the standards for detached accessory dwellings and the height standards for detached accessory buildings in TMC 18.60.020 .

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 325
references.quote: (5) Owner Occupancy Required. Either the accessory dwelling unit or the principal dwelling unit shall be occupied by an owner of record of the property.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 326
references.quote: (6) Building Design Guidelines for All Types of ADUs.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 327
references.quote: (i) The exterior finish material shall be visually compatible in type, size and placement with the exterior finish material of the principal dwelling.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 328
references.quote: (ii) The roof pitch shall be similar or compatible with the predominant roof pitch of the principal dwelling.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 329
references.quote: (iii) Trim on edges of elements on the addition shall be similar or compatible with in type, size and location as the trim used on the rest of the principal dwelling.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 330
references.quote: (iv) Windows shall match those in the principal dwelling in proportion and orientation.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 331
references.quote: (v) Eaves shall project from the building wall the same distance as the eaves on the rest of the principal dwelling.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 332
references.quote: (vi) If the ADU is converted from an existing detached building, the exterior shall be modified to the greatest extent possible to match or be comparable to the principal dwelling.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 333
references.quote: (7) Parking Standards.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 334
references.quote: (i) One off-street parking space on a hard surface meeting City of Topeka standards shall be provided in addition to the off-street parking required for the principal dwelling.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 335
references.quote: (ii) For lots with a single street frontage of less than 100 feet, additional off-street parking and driveway access for the accessory dwelling shall be from the existing parking and driveway access. Lots abutting an alley may provide parking access to the ADU from the alley.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 336
references.quote: (iii) For corner lots or lots with alley access, off-street parking and driveway access shall either be:

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 337
references.quote: (A) Integrated with existing parking and driveway access; or

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 338
references.quote: (B) Provided on the street frontage other than where the parking and driveway access for the principal dwelling is located or provided from the alley.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 339
references.quote: (8) Existing buildings with legal nonconforming setbacks may be converted to ADUs provided building codes are met.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 340
references.quote: (9) ADUs shall comply with applicable building codes and dimensional standards in TMC 18.60.020 and Chapter 18.230 TMC of the Zoning Code unless stated otherwise in these standards.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 341
references.quote: (10) Upon review of an application for a building permit that includes information as determined by the Planning and Development Director, the Director will determine whether the application meets the requirements of this section.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 342
references.quote: (11) Addressing. The property owner shall make arrangements with the Planning and Development Department to obtain a separate address or unit number for purposes of mail delivery to the accessory dwelling unit.

references.label: TMC 18.225.010 block 343
references.quote: (12) ADUs that do not meet standards in subsections (mm)(4) , (mm)(5) , and (mm)(6) of this section may be approved by conditional use permit (CUP) in accordance with Chapter 18.215 TMC. (Ord. 20640 § 2, 2-17-26; Ord. 20631 § 60, 1-13-26; Ord. 20500 § 4, 7-30-24.)
